title: Partner & Cloud Marketplace Sync — AWS / GCP / Azure — Nov 2025
content:
Meeting prep + scratchpad for partner / cloud marketplace syncs

Meeting context:
- Weekly cadence with cloud GTM and channel partners to align on marketplace listings, co-sell motions, billing models, and technical validation.
- Goal for this meeting: identify blockers for the upcoming AWS Marketplace listing push, confirm GCP procurement pilot timeline, and validate Azure Gov packaging for prospective public-sector customers.

Meeting date/time:
- Proposed: 2025-11-14 10:00-11:00 PT (confirm with partners)
- Attendees (internal): Jordan Martin (owner), Priya Rao (sales lead), Miguel Alvarez (solutions engineering), Sofia Chen (security/compliance)
- Partner reps: AWS (Marketplace PM: Ana K.), GCP (Partner Eng: Vikram S.), Azure (Marketplace Ops: Emily L.), Channel Partner: CloudBridge (BD: Tom W.)

Agenda (30/20/10 -> time boxed):
1) Quick intros & objectives (5m)
2) AWS Marketplace status & blockers (15m)
   - Confirm listing status: private beta -> public listing timeline
   - Billing model: SaaS subscription vs. metered usage; invoicing cadence
   - Technical validation: listed connectors, SSO/KMS integrations, 3rd-party audit artifacts
3) GCP procurement pilot & billing flow (10m)
   - Pilot start date, success metrics, sample SOW, billing integration (Billing API)
4) Azure Gov packaging and compliance checklist (10m)
   - Required artifacts for GovCloud and FedRAMP posture; customer supply chain questions
5) Channel partner enablement & co-sell ops (10m)
   - CloudBridge enablement materials, joint webinar timeline, GTM funds
6) Action items & next steps (10m)

Prep notes / things to bring:
- Jordan: one-slide summary of listing differences across AWS/GCP/Azure (pricing, billing mode, lead routing).
- Priya: list of target customers we want to onboard via marketplace this quarter (3 names) + expected ARR per deal.
- Miguel: tech checklist + PR for marketplace connector (link to PR: GITHUB-PR-982).
- Sofia: compliance artifacts: SOC2 cert, data flow diagram, KMS integration note; check any additional docs for Azure Gov.
- Ask partners for expected review SLAs and contact for packaging issues.

Partner-specific talking points / scratchpad:
- AWS Marketplace
  - Status: in private beta with 2 customers; AWS PM asked for a final technical prereq doc by 11/18.
  - Blocking issues: invoice flow for metered usage (need mapping of per-token metrics to AWS metering dimensions), marketplace terms vs Redwood T&Cs (legal to confirm).
  - Action ask: Get contact for billing integration engineer; ask for recommended metering patterns for tokenized products.
  - Notes: Ana mentioned potential listing boost if we join the "GenAI" co-sell program — need to confirm requirements.

- GCP Marketplace
  - Status: exploratory — GCP partner engineering suggested a procurement pilot for one enterprise account.
  - Blocking issues: Billing API integration details; need a sandbox project and service account with billing permissions.
  - Action ask: Ask Vikram for sandbox project ID + sample billing flow doc; propose pilot kickoff week of 11/24.

- Azure Marketplace / Azure Gov
  - Status: packaging for public Azure marketplace in progress; Azure Gov needs additional compliance artifacts and a dedicated SKU packaging.
  - Blocking issues: FedRAMP and customer data isolation requirements for Gov customers; need to confirm KMS/HSM compatibility and network flow diagrams.
  - Action ask: Request Azure Gov packaging checklist and recommended SKU mapping.

Channel partners (CloudBridge)
- Status: engaged for joint GTM into mid-market verticals; CloudBridge expects enablement package and co-branded webinar by Dec.
- Action ask: Provide CloudBridge with a 30-min enablement session + one-pager with value props and pricing. Assign enablement owner.

Risk / open questions (scratch list):
- Metered billing granularity: token-level vs. request-level — what will partners accept? Impacts reporting and invoices.
- Marketplace lead routing: how to capture lead source and attribute revenue to Redwood vs. channel.
- Legal: standard marketplace terms vs Redwood enterprise terms — where do we need carve-outs? (Ping Legal: Noah K.)
- Pricing: whether to list a "metered" SKU alongside a "seat/subscription" SKU; implications for SSO and seats.

Action items (owners + due dates):
- Miguel: Finalize PR for AWS metering adapter + include sample meter mapping (due 2025-11-18) [GITHUB-PR-982].
- Jordan: Draft marketplace comparison slide and send to partners before meeting (due 2025-11-12).
- Priya: Prepare list of 3 target customers + ARR expectations for pilot (due 2025-11-13).
- Sofia: Collect compliance artifacts (SOC2, data flow diagram, KMS note) and confirm Azure Gov gaps (due 2025-11-17).
- Jordan + Priya: Draft follow-up email to partners summarizing asks and next steps (send within 24h of meeting).
- CloudBridge enablement: Assign internal owner (recommended: Priya) + schedule enablement session (target week of 12/01).

Follow-up email draft (to edit after meeting):
Subject: Follow-up & next steps — Marketplace sync (AWS/GCP/Azure)
Hi all,
Thanks for the sync today. Short recap and next steps:
- AWS: Miguel to send final metering adapter by 11/18; AWS to share billing engineer contact (Ana).
- GCP: Vikram to provision sandbox project + Billing API notes; propose pilot kickoff week of 11/24.
- Azure: Emily to share Gov packaging checklist; Sofia to follow up on FedRAMP questions.
- CloudBridge: Priya to schedule enablement + one-pager by 11/30.
Attached: marketplace comparison slide, compliance artifact list, sample PR link.
Looking forward to next sync — please reply if dates conflict.
Thanks,
Jordan

Notes / meeting scratch (to capture during the call):
- Timestamp key decisions (e.g., acceptance of metered billing model).
- Capture named contacts and best channel for follow-up (email vs. support ticket).
- Record any ask for Redwood to produce partner-specific collateral.

Post-meeting checklist (quick):
- Send follow-up email within 24h.
- Create Jira tickets for technical work (include PR link) and tag eng triage.
- Update Confluence playbook with any new marketplace requirements.
- Schedule next sync (propose weekly until listing is public).

Misc notes / context / links (quick references):
- Confluence playbook: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/GTM/partner-marketplace-playbook
- PR for metering adapter: GITHUB-PR-982
- Legal owner for marketplace T&Cs: Noah K. (legal@redwood.ai)
- Related Jira: JIRA-3241 (AWS marketplace launch), JIRA-3270 (Azure Gov compliance)

End of scratchpad.
